name: LZR 338 265 GEN2 (Lazer, 265 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".720 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, printed ".369 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 4, Lazer - Ultra Long Range Hunting: Caliber .338, Grains 265, Minimum Required Twist *1-10", Part Number LZR 338 265 GEN2, G1 BC .720 (A.B.), G7 BC .369 (A.B.), OAL 1.913", Bullet Projection 1.029"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1-2 inches faster is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.029". The same G1 .720 and G7 .369 are printed for MTAC 338 254 MAX.
